newsitem.title: USA: Capstead sees porfolio profits up 15 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Capstead sees porfolio profits up 15 pct in 1997.

text.p: Capstead Mortgage Corp said on Wednesday that it expects its mortgage servicing portfolio profits to grow 15 percent in 1997.
The company said in a news release that it plans to buy an additional $1.6 billion of primary mortgage servicing with a weighted average interest rate of 7.42 percent.

That move, together with the expected increase to its subservicing portfolio, should increase the total servicing portfolio to almost $48 billion by the end of August, up from $45.9 billion as of June 30.
Capstead reported second quarter net income per share of $0.66, compared to $0.60 for the year-ago period.
